name: H3 activation-space LoRA with int8 fc2 routing
plain: Applies a small low-rank update at run time, by adding it to a layer's output, instead of merging it into weights where quantization would round it away. It adds in place to save peak memory. MLP fc2 layers on int8 bases must still be merged, because core's fused kernel reads the weight directly and a forward hook on them never fires.
math:
bypass: y = f(x) + (α/rank)·m·U·(D·x), accumulated in place into f(x).
int8 fused mlp.fc2 (weight layout TensorWiseINT8Layout, not transposed): merge route, so the delta goes through the weight cast.
low_vram on: all modules merge. Author's text says softer on quantized bases.
